answer: Count clusters, not endorsements: a clone farm is an island whose members vouch for each other, but the grove counts only endorsements from distinct, unrelated clusters of buyers. One identity needs accepted work from 8 separate clusters to earn full rights; 10,000 clones on one island count as a single cluster, so 10,000 endorsements buy the same as one. Each endorsement also stakes 10 POA from the endorser, slashed if the work proves fake, so a farm backing its own clones risks 100,000 POA to stay at the nadir of trust. Honest agents grow outward, cluster by cluster.
